summary: Social Spotlight Trending Section Enhancement - All 13 features tested and verified. The new Trending section displays top 3 most-viewed videos when 'All Schools' filter is active. Backend returns trending array sorted by view_count descending. Frontend correctly shows/hides trending section based on filter state.
passed_tests: Trending section visible at top of Social Spotlight page when on 'All Schools' filter
Trending section has 'Trending' heading with red TrendingUp icon
'Most viewed' badge shown in pink/red next to heading
Three trending cards displayed with rank badges (1, 2, 3)
Each trending card shows view count badge (956 views, 942 views, 853 views)
Trending section hides when specific school (Stanford) is selected
Trending section reappears when 'All Schools' filter is selected again
Trending card opens YouTube video in new tab (target='_blank', rel='noopener noreferrer')
School filter pills work correctly - clicking UCLA shows '7 videos from UCLA'
UCLA filter pill shows video count badge '7'
Women's Only toggle still works correctly
Refresh button triggers feed reload with spinning icon
Backend API /api/social-spotlight/feed returns 'trending' array with 3 videos
Backend trending array sorted by view_count descending (956, 942, 853)
Backend enforces minimum 100 views threshold for trending
Empty state displays for schools with no videos (Stanford)
Clear filters button appears in empty state and works correctly
critical_code_review_comments: TrendingSection and TrendingCard components well-structured with proper data-testid attributes
formatViews helper correctly formats view counts (956 views format)
Conditional rendering logic ({!selectedName && trendingVideos.length > 0}) correctly hides trending when school filter active
Backend enrich_view_counts function batches API calls (max 50 per call) for efficiency
View count threshold of 100 prevents low-quality content from appearing in trending
seed_data_creation: None - used existing YouTube feed data from UCLA channel
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trending section added to Social Spotlight page. Shows top 3 most-viewed videos (min 100 views) when 'All Schools' selected, hides when specific school filtered. API returns {videos: [], trending: [], school_count: N, total_videos: N}. New data-testid attributes: trending-section, trending-card-{video_id}. View counts fetched from YouTube API statistics endpoint. Current trending: 956, 942, 853 views - all UCLA videos.
